name: agent-os
description: An AI-native operating system for running teams of autonomous AI agents

scripts.check:macos: sh -c 'cd apps/macos && node_modules/.bin/tsc --build && node_modules/.bin/vite build && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node_modules/.bin/tauri build --debug --no-bundle'
scripts.verify: tsc --build && pnpm run check:types && biome check . && node scripts/check-layers.mjs && node scripts/check-native-boundary.mjs && vitest run && pnpm run check:macos
